readable.description: false when the photos show no shop receipt; then lines is []

shopName.description: the shop's name as printed, or ""

date.description: the purchase date as YYYY-MM-DD, or "" when it cannot be read

totalCents.description: the total paid in minor units, or -1 when it cannot be read

lines.description: one entry per bought line, in receipt order

row.description: the index of the Scanned row this line is, or -1 when none

count.description: packs bought on this line; 0 for a weighed line

grams.description: the weight of a weighed line in grams; 0 otherwise

priceCents.description: the amount of the line after its own discount, minor units; -1 if unreadable

unitPriceCents.description: the price of one pack if printed, else -1

perKgCents.description: the price per kg (or per litre) if printed, else -1

name.description: row -1: a short Product name from the line; a matched row: a corrected name only if the row's is clearly wrong; else ""

packSize.description: the pack size printed on the line, in packUnit; 0 if not printed

packUnit.description: the unit of packSize; "" when packSize is 0
